title: A relative Proj of a graded algebra generated in degree one by a finite type module is projective over the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the relative Proj of a graded algebra generated in degree one by a finite type module is a projective morphism (statement lines 7802-7810). The counted proof is short and complete: generation in degree one means the canonical map from the symmetric algebra on the degree one part is surjective, so by the cited construction the relative Proj embeds as a closed subscheme of the projective bundle of the degree one part, which is a projective bundle over the base because that module is of finite type (proof lines 7812-7822). It is H2: the reduction is carried out in the counted span and the cited input is the standard closed immersion of relative Proj's induced by a surjection from a symmetric algebra.
